purpose: Validate the distinct exact sign-probability estimand on an asymmetric sign-null law;not mean-zero calibration
signs: Independent fair Bernoulli signs for every seed and hypothesis,independent across replicate families;no sample sign balancing or centering
magnitudes: Base marginal Exp(scale1) values correlated through an equicorrelated .5 Gaussian copula,using a random stream independent of signs
differences: If sign positive,D=base Exp(scale1);if negative,D=-3*base Exp(scale1),so conditional negative magnitude is Exp(scale3). Population q=P(D>0)=.5 and population mean=-1.
scientific_null: P(positive contrast | nonzero)=.5;all differences continuous and nonzero. The distribution is asymmetric and its mean is NOT0.
inference: Actual production sign_comparison exact two-sided binomial p-values;global Holm across all4hypotheses;alpha.05. No mean sign-flip p-values and no bootstrap required.
uncertainty: Family rejection count among128independent replicate families,with exact95%Clopper-Pearson interval;per-hypothesis counts separately. Do not pool4correlated hypotheses as512independent families.
pilot: Independent4family runtime pilot only;retain128 main replicates. If projected duration exceeds100seconds,pause before main rather than adapt to pilot outcomes.
provenance: Protocol before data;production helper source and compiled-code hashes;actual imported helper used;no production edits
known_answers: Both all-positive and all-negative n8vectors give exact two-sided p=2/256;direction reversal maps q to1-q while preservingp;ties and missingness retain explicit denominators and p1 for all ties;complete Holm4 family
interpretation: This validates q,not expected-error superiority,mean significance,or phase completeness in the original population. The earlier centered-lognormal mean-null stress result is not a failure of exact sign inference.
